title: Victory! Flock Ends Rollout of Audio “Distress Detection” of Human Voices
summary: EFF celebrates Flock Safety's decision to end its pilot of 'Distress Detection,' a feature on its acoustic gunshot detection devices that would have listened for sounds like screaming. EFF warns that the underlying microphones and gunshot detection remain problematic and frames the reversal as a product of public pressure.

key_quotes.quote: Flock has published a blog post stating that "[a]fter careful consideration and community consultation, we decided to remove the feature."

Gunshot detecting microphones eventually being used to listen for screaming is exactly the type of mission creep that we've seen happen with other pieces of surveillance technology, including Flock's license plate readers.
